about: Proposed text_blocks.read_aloud overrides for screen and figure blocks: a short spoken description used by narration instead of the block's HTML. Drafted with model help from text_blocks.data.fields and the surrounding prose. Each is pinned to the block's sha256; if the block changes, the override no longer applies. status 'unreviewed' means no person has signed off yet.

overrides.read_aloud: Five messages. From Febric: Hreda and I are both safely inside the Greater Plum Harbor. We will survive the best that we can. We love you. Then four from Hreda: Northglade was invaded this morning. It looked like there were barely any battles, as though our politicians and army are totally okay with this happening. Febric and I are safely inside the Greater Plum Harbor. The Arctics seem to be respecting it as some kind of neutral zone, at least for now. I'm scared. I hope everything will be okay. Love you.
Her watch shows a green check: Frequent contact of Gladias. Proof verified.
A notification, beside a small flame: Fifty zipcoins have just been burned.
